name: cursor-setting-sync
description: Securely synchronize Cursor settings, workspace state, profiles, extensions, user files, and chat data across devices.

cursorSettingSync.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Fallback interval for scanning the shared repository.

cursorSettingSync.chatPollIntervalSecond.description: Interval for checking Cursor chat metadata changes.

cursorSettingSync.autoApplyFiles.description: Apply non-conflicting file resources while Cursor is running.

cursorSettingSync.syncWorkspaceStorage.description: Back up allowlisted Cursor workspaceStorage data after Cursor exits and restore it offline.

cursorSettingSync.syncLocalWorkspaces.description: Back up and write workspaceStorage for local folder workspaces (file://) as well as Remote-SSH ones. Off by default: a local folder path exists on exactly one computer unless both machines happen to use the identical path, so its incoming storage usually has nothing to match on the other side and does nothing but sit in the queue asking to be mapped to a workspace that is not there. Turn it on if the same projects live at the same paths on every computer. Remote-SSH workspaces are always synchronized; chats are unaffected either way. Machine-scoped, so it does not travel between computers.
cursorSettingSync.syncLocalWorkspaces.markdownDescription: Back up and write workspaceStorage for local folder workspaces (`file://`) as well as Remote-SSH ones. **Off by default**: a local folder path exists on exactly one computer unless both machines happen to use the identical path, so its incoming storage usually has nothing to match on the other side and does nothing but sit in the queue asking to be mapped to a workspace that is not there. Turn it on if the same projects live at the same paths on every computer. Remote-SSH workspaces are always synchronized; chats are unaffected either way. Machine-scoped, so it does not travel between computers.

cursorSettingSync.ignoredWorkspaces.description: Further workspaces whose workspaceStorage this computer neither backs up nor writes, on top of the local-folder exclusion that cursorSettingSync.syncLocalWorkspaces controls. Entries are matched against the workspace URI, and the percent-encoded form Cursor stores is matched against the readable pattern you write. Wildcards such as vscode-remote://ssh-remote+staging* are supported. This setting is machine-scoped and does not travel between computers. Chats are not affected.

cursorSettingSync.ignoredSettings.description: Settings keys excluded from synchronization. Each entry is an exact key such as editor.fontSize or a wildcard such as remote.SSH.* ; * matches any characters.

cursorSettingSync.useDefaultIgnoredSetti.description: Exclude a built-in list of machine-specific settings (window.zoomLevel, terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.*, terminal.integrated.shell*, git.path, http.proxy*, remote.SSH.*, and similar) that describe this computer rather than a preference. Keys VS Code Settings Sync itself propagates, such as terminal.integrated.profiles.*, are not on the list. Turn this off to synchronize them anyway.

cursorSettingSync.ignoredExtensions.description: Extension identifiers excluded from synchronization. Each entry is an exact ID such as ms-python.python or a wildcard such as ms-python.* ; matching ignores case.

cursorSettingSync.ignoredUiStateKeys.description: UI state keys excluded from synchronization. Each entry is an exact key such as workbench.activity.pinnedViewlets2 or a wildcard such as workbench.panel.* . Use this for per-machine layout you want to keep local; an ignored key is never deleted on other devices.

cursorSettingSync.ignoredUserFiles.description: Cursor home user files excluded from synchronization, as relative paths such as mcp.json or rules/private.md. A directory entry such as rules/ excludes everything under it, and wildcards such as rules/*.md or skills/**/secret.md are supported. Use this for files containing API keys.

cursorSettingSync.gitSync.description: When the repository folder is a git worktree, pull before reading and commit/push after writing. Requires the git CLI.

cursorSettingSync.maxPayloadMiB.description: Maximum uncompressed size of one synchronized payload.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --out cursor-setting-sync.vsix
scripts.publish:patch: npm run build && vsce publish patch
scripts.publish:minor: npm run build && vsce publish minor
scripts.publish:major: npm run build && vsce publish major
